basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Chemistry at the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (Research & Development Office) has invited applications for one temporary Project Research Scientist I position on the project "Targeting Tousled-Like Kinase 1 in Glioblastoma-Biology, Substrate Identification and Structure-Guided Inhibitor Designing". The appointment is for 01 year at a consolidated ₹61,600 per month including HRA. The essential qualification is a PhD in Chemistry, Biological Sciences, or Allied disciplines. Apply through recruitment.iitgn.ac.in by 30 November 2026 (Advt No. SPON/70141/Advt0379 dat

how_to_apply: The notice gives an application link, http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/, and 30.11.2026 as the last date of application submission. It prints no further steps and no document list. For queries, the contact given is Prof. Sivapriya Kirubakaran, [email protected].
important_instructions: Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment; a higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves the right not to call an applicant for a selection test, or not to fill the position through this round of selection, without assigning any reason. The position is temporary for 01 Year.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar, Research & Development Office
Targeting Tousled-Like Kinase 1 in Glioblastoma-Biology, Substrate Identification and Structure-Guided Inhibitor Designing

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Research & Development Office of the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar. The post sits in the Department of Chemistry under the Principal Investigator (PI) Prof. Sivapriya Kirubakaran. The project title is "Targeting Tousled-Like Kinase 1 in Glioblastoma-Biology, Substrate Identification and Structure-Guided Inhibitor Designing". The notice does not name a funding agency; it ticks "Institute norms" and not "Funding Agency norms" for eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is a PhD in Chemistry, Biological Sciences, or Allied disciplines, with a strong record of scientific publications. Candidates who have submitted their doctoral thesis are also eligible to apply. The notice does not print an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.details: Minimum 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards
Previous experience in molecular biology and cell biology will be taken as advantage

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice calls this the consolidated monthly remuneration including HRA. House Rent Allowance per month is listed as "10% (₹5,600/-)" with the words "If applicable". The duration of appointment is 01 Year, and the position is described as temporary.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Research Scientist I Job Description
content_sections.text: The desired candidate must have strong skills in synthetic organic chemistry and interest in interdisciplinary science. Previous experience in molecular biology and cell biology will be taken as advantage.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Project Research Scientist I
content_sections.text: The notice gives an application link, http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ , and 30.11.2026 as the last date of application submission. It prints no further steps and no document list. For queries, the contact given is Prof. Sivapriya Kirubakaran, [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment; a higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves the right not to call an applicant for a selection test, or not to fill the position through this round of selection, without assigning any reason. The position is temporary for 01 Year.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Gandhinagar Project Research Scientist I recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 01 position of Project Research Scientist I in the Department of Chemistry.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application submission is 30.11.2026 (30 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A PhD in Chemistry, Biological Sciences, or Allied disciplines, with a strong record of scientific publications. Marks must be at least 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards and 55% or equivalent in class 10th and 12th.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates who have only submitted their PhD thesis apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says candidates who have submitted their doctoral thesis are also eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Research Scientist I?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is ₹61,600/- pm, made up of ₹56,000/- pm plus 10% HRA of ₹5,600/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹61,600 pay?
faq.answer: No, the ₹61,600 figure is stated as including HRA. The notice lists HRA as 10% (₹5,600/-) with the note "If applicable".

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply through the application link http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ on or before 30.11.2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a temporary position with a duration of appointment of 01 Year.

faq.question: Q9. Is experience in molecular biology required?
faq.answer: It is not listed as essential. The notice says previous experience in molecular biology and cell biology will be taken as advantage, and strong skills in synthetic organic chemistry are needed.
